title: Strategies for optimizing mechanical properties of refractory high entropy alloys induced by solid solution strengthening mechanism
process_description: prepared by arc melting using pure metals of Zr, Ti, Nb (>99.95 wt%) under high-purity argon atmosphere, re-melted and flipped at least seven times to ensure chemical homogeneity, then cast into a water-cooled copper mold (8 × 12 × 40 mm³)
